symptom: Auto-layout put objects on or behind their neighbours and `layout flows` called the flow already laid out (ako/mxcli#1773): an if/else followed by an activity inside a THEN branch put the enclosing merge inside that activity (5px reported; 20px when the decision opens the branch); a handler row ending in `join` reserved about twice its drawn width; a falling-through handler of two or more statements rejoined at a merge left of the row's last activity, so the edge ran backwards. mx check 0 errors in every case.
cause: Four measurer/builder disagreements. measureIfStatement measured from the split's centre as if it were the left edge (45px short) and gapBetween compensated after the IF only; measureStatements started every run at the left edge although the builder centres a first split where an activity's centre would be (15px short); measureBranch added an end event after any terminal statement, a join and a both-return IF included; and the rejoin merge was placed midway between the activity and the next one by mergeOnEdge while the row ran on past it. An IF/ELSE without a merge (one branch returns, or tailWithoutMerge at a loop body's end) was measured with a merge too.
file: mdl/executor/layout.go (measureRun, measureIf, gapBetween, lastStmtDrawsEndEvent), mdl/executor/layout_lanes.go (ifHasMerge, ifJoinsNothingAtTail, ifMainWidth, rejoinsPastRow, rejoinAfterRow), mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_flows.go (finishCustomErrorHandler, addErrorHandlerRejoinFlowForState)
insight: The cheapest exact oracle for a measurer is a loop: fitContainerSize sizes the box from what was BUILT, measureLoopStatement from what was MEASURED, so wrapping any run in `loop … end loop` and comparing the two widths catches every disagreement to the pixel, including over-measures that never overlap anything (the join case). It found two defects the issue did not name (the first-element offset, and a merge counted for merge-less IF/ELSEs). Distinguish the main-line cursor from the drawn extent: an IF without a merge resumes at a point that is not an edge of anything, and folding that point into the extent re-introduced an over-measure at a body's tail. A `merge` label statement advances only half a pitch, so gapBetween's 20px floor over-measured it; MDL refuses join/merge in loops (MDL-FLOW04), but the oracle still applies because a run is measured the same way wherever it is. Moves: 10 of 376 doctype-example flows (02c CX_SYNC_FactoryTelemetry 5465->4315 wide, CX_VAL_Factory, CX_VAL_EmailTemplate, CX_ACT_BatchProcessFactories, CX_ACT_HandleAuthCode; 02 M008_NestedIf, M093_GetCountryLabel; 07 M020, M050, M053) and 4 of 29 fixture flows; no golden test changed. Not this class: vertical measurement (a Bounds height is not symmetric about the line, so an if-without-else inside nested loops pokes out of the outer box, MPR011) and a multi-value CASE outcome's own merge drawn on its first activity (documented at firstCaseGroupShift).
